snippet.title: Mini Plane trailer
snippet.description:
Mini Plane is a fun casual game available on iPhone and Android smartphones. The game is based on a very simple game concept, but in true OrangePixel fashion, it enhances the gameplay and then some.

Updates of the game feature new worlds, challenge modes, upgrade items to make your plane better, and much more 

http://orangepixel.net/miniplane
